recall: Kikea Store X-VESOLJE nursing pillows, model NP001 (CPSC 27-071)
product: C-shaped nursing pillow in one of the three recalled prints: white with blue flowers and green leaves, dark brown with multicoloured feathers, or multicoloured puzzle pieces. A pillow in any other print or a plain colour is not this product. The pillow carries no label or markings of its own, so the owner ties on a paper tag hand-written with X-VESOLJE and their one-time code
label_must_show: X-VESOLJE, hand-written on a paper tag tied to the pillow (the pillow itself carries no label)
proof_steps: The pillow is cut fully in half, so it can no longer be used
The X-VESOLJE tag is on the cut pillow
note: CPSC says the pillow carries no markings or labels, so the owner ties on a paper tag reading X-VESOLJE and the claim's one-time code. The prints are described from the CPSC photo. The notice asks for no claim number, so the one-time code is checked on its own.
